描述_EN: 1959 in heilongjiang), a professor of fashion design at tsinghua university in beijing. dr sun yat-sen (sun zhongshan), generally referred to the father of the republic of modern china, introduced a functional, minimalist tunic suit as official dress for civil servants. all this contributes to create a relaxed and contemporary feel. the jacket has a fold-over collar and four flap-patch pockets said to symbolise the four virtues − propriety, justice, honesty and shame. here, the chinese-born designer li wei follows faithfully the original 1920s design, but replaces the usual woollen fabric with silk and then dyes it in an ombré shade of pale blue. it was part of her haute couture collection showcased at the mercedes-benz china fashion week spring/summer 2015 in beijing in 2014. this man'suit was designed by li wei (b. this silk suit was li’s reinterpretation of the ‘zhongshan suit’ named after the revolutionary sun zhongshan (1866-1925), president of the republic of china for a brief period i 1912. the zhongshan suit became an iconic sartorial symbol of modern china, appealing to artists, designers and fashion trendsetters alike.
描述_ZN: 1959年生于黑龙江），北京清华大学的服装设计教授。 孙中山先生（孙中山），一般被称为现代中国的共和国之父，引入了一种功能性的、简约的长衫套装作为公务员的官方服装。 所有这些都有助于创造一种轻松和现代的感觉。 外套有一个折叠领和四个翻盖口袋，据说象征着四种美德--礼、义、廉、耻。 在这里，出生在中国的设计师李伟忠实地遵循了20世纪20年代的原始设计，但用丝绸取代了通常的毛织品，然后将其染成混色的淡蓝色。 这是她在2014年北京梅赛德斯-奔驰中国时装周上展示的高级定制系列的一部分。 这套男装是由李伟（b. 这套丝绸套装是李宇春对 "中山装 "的重新诠释，中山装是以革命家孙中山（1866-1925）命名的，他曾在1912年短暂担任过中华民国的总统。 中山装成为现代中国的标志性服装符号，吸引了艺术家、设计师和时尚潮流人士的关注。
